facts.text: DepthPublisher declares the absolute /depth topic with std_msgs/Float64.
AUV.SendDepth publishes vehicle.transform.position.y as a Float64Msg on the depth topic.
HeadingPublisher declares the absolute /imu/HeadingTrue_degree topic with std_msgs/Float64.
AUV.SendHeading publishes vehicle.transform.rotation.eulerAngles.y as a Float64Msg on the heading topic.
imuPublisher declares the absolute /imu/data topic with sensor_msgs/Imu.
AUV.Start leaves the ros.AddPublisher(typeof(imuPublisher)) registration commented out.
ImuSubscriberCallback subscribes to the absolute /imu/data topic with sensor_msgs/Imu.
ImuSubscriberCallback.CallBack sets the Capsule's transform.rotation from the received IMU quaternion.
AUV.Start opens a ROSBridgeWebSocketConnection to ws://192.168.0.100 on port 9090.
The vendored SimpleJSON.cs carries the MIT License, Copyright (c) 2012-2017 Markus Göbel.
AUV.SendImu builds sensor_msgs/Imu with the vehicle quaternion, zero angular-velocity and linear-acceleration vectors, covariance arrays and a header.
CompressedImagePublisher declares the absolute /image/compressed topic with sensor_msgs/CompressedImage.
AUV.SendImage reads a 640x480 RGB24 texture, encodes JPEG, sets the format string 'jpeg' and publishes a CompressedImageMsg on the compressed-image topic.
AUV.Start registers the CompressedImage, Depth and Heading publishers plus the Thruster and Imu subscriber callbacks.
AUV.Update has every StartCoroutine call for image, depth, IMU and heading commented out.
ThrusterCallback declares the absolute /thruster topic with type thrusters/ThrusterMsg.
ThrusterCallback subtracts 290 from each field and calls AddForceAtPosition on the capsule Rigidbody.
The ROS thruster node imports thrusterMsg from control.msg but passes thruster, which these lines do not define, as the rospy.Publisher message class.
control/thruster.msg defines eight uint16 thruster fields.
The control CMake action list contains heave, pitch, sway, yaw, roll and surge only; no stop, pause or reset action is generated.
heave.action carries only a float32 final value in its result, with no success or failure field.
The heave action server uses an undefined Float64 name, reads self.heave before assignment, references an undefined successt name and an undefined req name, and has no set_aborted path.
The roll server imports a control.srv roll type and creates a rospy.Service on roll_service.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned replies with no physics step, pacing or state-hash replay; the same placeholder sample is returned on every subscription

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free canned transport: it answers the declared /depth, /imu/HeadingTrue_degree and /imu/data subscriptions and runs no Unity scene, ROS graph, physics, buoyancy, collision or sensor simulation

the pinned AUV.Update leaves the telemetry coroutines commented out, so the declared publishers do not run in the pinned scene; the fake's samples are placeholders and a live run needs the operator to start a publisher or enable those coroutines
the fake returns one placeholder sample per subscription; it establishes no sample age, publisher rate, sensor frame, trajectory or physical quantity

the package binds no motion/control: /thruster accepts eight forces in the Unity subscriber, but the ROS publisher is broken and no acknowledged stop, pause, step or reset endpoint exists in the pinned source; the action servers and the mission planner are NOT COVERED

the fake has no image, depth-image or point-cloud path; the CompressedImage publisher is declared but its coroutine is commented out and this package does not capture image artifacts. /depth is a scalar Float64 topic, not a depth camera

in the pinned scene /imu/data is an input, not simulator output: the IMU publisher is not registered (AUV.cs:28) and ImuSubscriberCallback sets the vehicle rotation from every received sample, and no ROS node in the clone publishes it (the sensor package is empty), so the IMU observation returns another client's sample that also rotates the simulated vehicle; enabling SendImu as well would feed the scene's own rotation back into it
the scene's rosbridge address is hard-coded to ws://192.168.0.100:9090 (AUV.cs:25); a live run needs a rosbridge there or an edited scene, and every observation fails NOT_READY until a publisher runs

SendImu would stamp its header with TimeSpan.Seconds and Milliseconds (AUV.cs:94), the second component rather than total seconds and milliseconds in the nanosecond field; the fake's stamp is a placeholder

measures.description: Subscribe to one fresh /depth Float64 sample from the Unity simulator and return its raw data value. The clone publishes Unity world Y and states no unit or depth datum.
measures.name: read_depth

measures.description: Subscribe to one fresh /imu/HeadingTrue_degree Float64 sample and return the raw heading value in degrees as declared by the topic name.
measures.name: read_heading

measures.description: Subscribe to one fresh /imu/data sensor_msgs/Imu sample and return the message fields. In the pinned scene /imu/data is an input that sets the simulated vehicle's rotation and the scene's own IMU publisher is not registered, so the sample comes from another publisher, not from the simulator; no unit or frame convention is stated in the clone.
measures.name: read_imu

safe_state.description: No actuation is bound: this package only subscribes to the simulator's declared telemetry topics and commands no motion, so an MHS e-stop is the runtime software latch and no native or physical stop is claimed.
